programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1980: Greg Norman's First Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 1980: Greg Norman's First Aus Open Win. The Lakes Golf Club: Greg Norman, a young Queenslander with the world at his feet, took another step along the road to golfing greatness by winning his first Australian Open in 1980. He would later go on to win five at this event.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph
programme.desc: 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph. Royal Melbourne: Tom Watson triumphs in the playoff to become the fifth American to win this Tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1985: Greg Norman Wins Historic Aus Open
programme.desc: 1985: Greg Norman Wins Historic Aus Open. Royal Melbourne: Going into the final round there wasa four-way tie for the lead, but Greg Norman thundered to victory. Norman becomes fourth player to win both the Australian PGA and the Australian Open in the same year.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1987: Greg Norman Makes Aus Open History
programme.desc: 1987: Greg Norman Makes Aus Open History. Royal Melbourne: In spectacular style, Greg Norman absolutely decimated the field at the Australian Open by a whopping 10 strokes. That winning margin was also the largest in the history of the event.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open
programme.desc: 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open. Kingston Heath, Melbourne: In tricky wind conditions, the World No. 1 Greg Norman holed a 40-foot birdie putt off the 17th green to set up a two-shot victory to win his fourth title in this tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent
programme.desc: 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent. Royal Syndey: Three weeks after he completed his year 12 exams, Aaron Baddeley went and won an Australian Open at 18 years of age. He became the first amateur since Bruce Devlin in 1960 to win the national Open.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /26 - Australian Open Final Round
programme.desc: Australian Open Final Round. The 2025 Australian Open concludes from the iconic Royal Melbourne Golf Club.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open
programme.desc: 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open. The Lakes, Sydney: Australian left-hander Greg Chalmers held his nerve to win the Australian Open for the second time in his career, 13 years after his first win. He held off a late charge by John Senden and Tiger Woods to claim victory.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win
programme.desc: 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win. Royal Sydney: With the biggest crowds in years congregating around the 18th green, Rory McIlroy made a birdie at the final hole to stop Adam Scott from completing the Triple Crown in 2013.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win. Australian Golf Club, Sydney: Matt Jones survived a nerve-jangling final round to outlast world No.1 Jordan Spieth and a bolting Adam Scott to win the Australian Open.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win. Royal Sydney Golf Club: Jordan Speith squeezes into a three-way play-off with Australians Ashley Hall and Cameron Smith, then duly banked an uphill 15-footer for birdie to win a gripping tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2017: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2017: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: Just 24-years-old at the time, then rising star Cam Smith claims the 2017 Australian PGA Championship in a playoff thriller.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2019: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2019: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: In a field that included high profle players such as Adam Scott and Sergio Garcia, it was one shot by Matt Jones that saw him win the Australian Open.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /23 AUSTRALIAN OPEN - 22' Final Round
programme.desc: 22' Final Round. The final round of the Australian Open gets underway from Victoria Golf Course. Adrian Meronk finished Round 3 14-under par to Adam Scott’s 9-under, and Min Woo Lee's 8-under, so who will take out the title?

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open
programme.desc: 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open. The Australian Golf Club: Joaquin Niemann wowed the crowds when he put on a spectacular display in storming home on the final day. The Chilean defeatedJapan’s Rikuya Hoshino in extra holes with Australia’s Min Woo Lee finishing third.

programme.desc: 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open. Kingston Heath, Melbourne: In tricky wind conditions, the World No. 1 Greg Norman holed a 40-foot birdie putt off the 17th green to set up a two-shot victory to win his fourth title in this tournament.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /26 - Australian Open Final Round
programme.desc: Australian Open Final Round. The 2025 Australian Open concludes from the iconic Royal Melbourne Golf Club.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent
programme.desc: 1999: Aaron Baddeley's Aus Open Ascent. Royal Syndey: Three weeks after he completed his year 12 exams, Aaron Baddeley went and won an Australian Open at 18 years of age. He became the first amateur since Bruce Devlin in 1960 to win the national Open.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open
programme.desc: 2011: Greg Chalmers Wins Second Aus Open. The Lakes, Sydney: Australian left-hander Greg Chalmers held his nerve to win the Australian Open for the second time in his career, 13 years after his first win. He held off a late charge by John Senden and Tiger Woods to claim victory.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win
programme.desc: 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win. Royal Sydney: With the biggest crowds in years congregating around the 18th green, Rory McIlroy made a birdie at the final hole to stop Adam Scott from completing the Triple Crown in 2013.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win. Australian Golf Club, Sydney: Matt Jones survived a nerve-jangling final round to outlast world No.1 Jordan Spieth and a bolting Adam Scott to win the Australian Open.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win. Royal Sydney Golf Club: Jordan Speith squeezes into a three-way play-off with Australians Ashley Hall and Cameron Smith, then duly banked an uphill 15-footer for birdie to win a gripping tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2017: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2017: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: Just 24-years-old at the time, then rising star Cam Smith claims the 2017 Australian PGA Championship in a playoff thriller.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2019: Australian Open Men's
programme.desc: 2019: Australian Open Men's. Australian Golf Club: In a field that included high profle players such as Adam Scott and Sergio Garcia, it was one shot by Matt Jones that saw him win the Australian Open.

programme.title: PGA AUSTRALIA /23 AUSTRALIAN OPEN - 22' Final Round
programme.desc: 22' Final Round. The final round of the Australian Open gets underway from Victoria Golf Course. Adrian Meronk finished Round 3 14-under par to Adam Scott’s 9-under, and Min Woo Lee's 8-under, so who will take out the title?

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open
programme.desc: 2023: Joaquin Niemann Stuns at Aus Open. The Australian Golf Club: Joaquin Niemann wowed the crowds when he put on a spectacular display in storming home on the final day. The Chilean defeatedJapan’s Rikuya Hoshino in extra holes with Australia’s Min Woo Lee finishing third.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph
